Power 
 Station
Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:Traveling Water 
 Screen System
 U-33300
 Magrini Galileo - Italy
Introduction
This document outlines the 
 major maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every five years as indicated 
by Y5 in the above titled block
The Traveling water screen system is used for cleaning the Nile River water 
utilized for the operation of the combined cycle power station from plastics, 
wood .... etc
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 11 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta power station head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPCo inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen mechanically and electrically.
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen mechanically and electrically.
Tools and Equipment
Maintenance tool set.
Grease (multi purpose grease).
Wires to raise up the screen cover.
Maintenance tool set.
Grease (multi purpose grease).
Wires to raise up the screen cover.
Work to be Carried Out
Change all left & right connecting 
 rods.
Change all sliding roller 
 bearings.
Change all sliding roller bearing 
 pins and guides (bushes).
Grease the sliding roller 
 bearings and pins.
Grease the motor roller bearing.
Grease the tie-rods
Check any wear of the washing 
 nozzles and treat it.
Check the bolts fixation to avoid 
 the vibration.
Repaint the screen and its 
 components to overcome the corrosion
